changes.title: Jack o lanterns
items: Jack-o'-lanterns at the party: four kinds of carved pumpkins, grinning, grim, surprised and stacked, glowing and casting a little warm light

changes.title: Station framing
items: At the wardrobe, dressing table, shoe rack and cloak pegs the camera frames her properly again: all of her on screen and the part you're choosing in the middle

changes.title: Dress spin
items: At the dressing stations she twirls on the spot each time you pick something new, and comes out of it wearing it
